nama_pdf: KAKEK HASAN DAN DIMAS - Sandal di Teras Masjid.pdf

halaman.script: Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. The covered front terrace of a small, clean Indonesian village mosque in the late afternoon: white tiled floor, a low wooden shoe rack against the green wall on the right, the open wooden mosque door on the left, warm golden sunlight Dimas, a small 9-year-old child 128 cm tall, 9-year-old Indonesian Muslim boy, 128 cm tall with a child's proportions, his head reaching Kakek Hasan's chest, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short spiky black hair, mustard-yellow long-sleeved koko shirt, black trousers, blue rubber sandals. Dimas stands at the edge of the white tiled terrace facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, wearing blue rubber sandals. Dimas steps out of his blue sandals one after the other; they land apart on the tiles. Only after both sandals are off, he turns his head toward the mosque door on the left. Camera on the mosque terrace at chest height, medium-wide shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Kakek Hasan, a grown adult 166 cm tall, 68-year-old Indonesian Muslim grandfather, 166 cm tall, slim, slightly stooped, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short neat white beard along the jaw, white knitted peci cap, light grey long-sleeved koko shirt, dark brown checkered sarong to the ankles, brown leather sandals. Kakek Hasan stands upright at the edge of the terrace facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his brown leather sandals on his feet. Kakek Hasan steps out of his brown sandals slowly and places them side by side. Then he bends his knees and picks up the two blue sandals with both hands. Camera on the mosque terrace at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Kakek Hasan, a grown adult 166 cm tall, 68-year-old Indonesian Muslim grandfather, 166 cm tall, slim, slightly stooped, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short neat white beard along the jaw, white knitted peci cap, light grey long-sleeved koko shirt, dark brown checkered sarong to the ankles, brown leather sandals. Kakek Hasan holds the two blue sandals at waist height. Kakek Hasan walks forward to the low wooden shoe rack on the right. Then he places the blue sandals neatly side by side on the rack with both hands. Camera beside the shoe rack at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Dimas, a small 9-year-old child 128 cm tall, 9-year-old Indonesian Muslim boy, 128 cm tall with a child's proportions, his head reaching Kakek Hasan's chest, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short spiky black hair, mustard-yellow long-sleeved koko shirt, black trousers, blue rubber sandals. Dimas stands in the open wooden mosque doorway facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his hands at his sides. Dimas raises his right hand and points toward the shoe rack on the right. Camera at the mosque doorway at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

balon.teks: Lho, Kek? Itu kan sandal Dimas.

Kakek Hasan, a grown adult 166 cm tall, 68-year-old Indonesian Muslim grandfather, 166 cm tall, slim, slightly stooped, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short neat white beard along the jaw, white knitted peci cap, light grey long-sleeved koko shirt, dark brown checkered sarong to the ankles, brown leather sandals. Kakek Hasan stands upright beside the low wooden shoe rack facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his right hand resting on top of the rack. Kakek Hasan pats the top of the shoe rack twice with his right hand. Camera beside the shoe rack at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

balon.teks: Merapikan sandal itu kecil, Dimas. Tapi Allah suka.

halaman.script: Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Dimas, a small 9-year-old child 128 cm tall, 9-year-old Indonesian Muslim boy, 128 cm tall with a child's proportions, his head reaching Kakek Hasan's chest, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short spiky black hair, mustard-yellow long-sleeved koko shirt, black trousers, blue rubber sandals. Dimas stands upright beside the low wooden shoe rack facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, one pair of grey sandals lying apart on the tiles in front of him. Dimas bends his knees, picks up the grey sandals with both hands, and places them neatly on the rack. Then he stands upright again. Camera beside the shoe rack at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

balon.teks: Sandal bapak itu juga, ya, Kek!

halaman.script: No people. The low wooden shoe rack with many sandals arranged neatly in pairs in warm golden light. The covered front terrace of a small, clean Indonesian village mosque just before Maghrib: white tiled floor, a low wooden shoe rack against the green wall on the right, the open wooden mosque door on the left, warm golden sunlight; no people Warm cinematic 3D animated style.

halaman.narasi: Iman itu lebih dari tujuh puluh cabang. Yang paling tinggi ucapan laa ilaaha illallah, yang paling rendah menyingkirkan gangguan dari jalan. Hadis riwayat Muslim.
